name: c3-execd
description: Go sidecar for cloud-infra-mcp / cloudy-c3-api / superapp-mcp: loopback exec with timeouts, pooled native SSH (x/crypto/ssh), policy-gated Docker unix-socket client and an audit log. Shadow stage: runs beside the Node helpers (shared/libs/exec.ts, ssh.ts), nothing calls it until switch-over (ticket #1875)

native_build._doc: Multi-stage: compiled in golang:1.24-bookworm on the arch-matched runner, shipped as one static binary on distroless static (no shell, no libc, non-root 65532). No apt/apk line: the base has neither.

api.description: POST /v1/exec, /v1/ssh, /v1/docker, GET /health on loopback; allowlisted commands, pooled ssh sessions, allowlisted docker engine calls, audit line per call.

_doc_addressing: Loopback only (127.0.0.1:4187, network_mode host on oci-apps beside cloudy-c3-api): no mesh name, no Caddy route, no Hickory row. Shadow stage: the Node tools still use spawnSync/ssh; the TS shadow hook (shared/libs/execd-shadow.ts, off unless C3_EXECD_URL is set) replays read-only calls here and logs match/mismatch.
